name: Torremolinos (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torremolinos (a tower and a mill on blue and yellow within an inscribed bordure).
history: Municipal flag of Torremolinos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
